Distributor and Agent Partnership: Key Information # How does YOHO ensure the stability of product supply? # YOHO maintains strict control over in-house safety inventory levels to guarantee a consistent supply of raw materials. Once a contract is finalized, a detailed production plan and delivery schedule are provided to serve as the foundation for production arrangements. Distributors also have the option to negotiate an inventory stocking mechanism with YOHO to address unexpected demand surges.
What is the policy on price adjustments? How does YOHO respond to market fluctuations? # YOHO informs distributors at least one month in advance of any price changes. If raw material costs increase by up to 8%, YOHO absorbs the additional cost and continuously monitors market trends for raw material prices.
Is there an opportunity for exclusive distribution rights in the market? What are the conditions? # YOHO may grant exclusive distribution rights in specific regions, depending on the distributor’s market development capabilities and performance. Typically, this requires a commitment to a certain sales volume or marketing investment, with all terms clearly specified in the contract.
Can distributors participate in the product development or improvement process? # Distributors are encouraged to provide feedback on product design or feature enhancements based on market needs. YOHO values this input for ongoing product improvement.
What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for orders? Can it be adjusted flexibly? # YOHO generally sets a minimum order quantity to ensure production efficiency. However, flexible arrangements can be negotiated, especially when launching new products or entering new markets.
What is the policy for product returns or exchanges? # The manufacturer typically has a return or exchange policy, with specific terms outlined in the contract. Distributors should pay attention to details such as return deadlines, product condition requirements, and any applicable fees.
What support is available for marketing campaigns and brand promotion? # YOHO provides marketing materials to assist distributors in boosting sales. Additionally, YOHO may participate in distributors’ marketing activities, offering subsidies or promotional support to enhance product visibility and sales in local markets.
Are there exclusive promo programs or discount policies? # YOHO offers exclusive promotional programs for distributors, including quarterly discounts, bulk purchase incentives, product trials, and display plans. Distributors can discuss specific promotional activities with YOHO to enhance market competitiveness.
Can YOHO provide product training and technical support? # YOHO offers product knowledge training to help distributors and their teams better understand product functions and features.
How to handle requests for customized products? # YOHO can customize products according to the requirements of a distributor’s customer. This typically involves a minimum order quantity and extended delivery time. The specific process and timeline should be discussed and confirmed with YOHO in advance.
How are product packaging and logistics support arranged? # YOHO provides standardized product packaging and logistics solutions. Distributors are responsible for ensuring that these packaging standards meet local market requirements. If there are specific packaging or logistics needs, distributors should discuss them with YOHO in advance to ensure compliance.
How are responsibilities for after-sales service and warranty allocated? # YOHO generally provides product warranty and technical support, while the distributor is responsible for the initial coordination of after-sales service.
How does YOHO handle product quality complaints from customers? # YOHO works closely with distributors to address quality complaints. This includes providing product inspection reports and solutions such as replacements or returns, as well as establishing an effective customer feedback management system to resolve issues promptly and protect the brand’s reputation.

This guide provides an overview of the collaboration process, service options, and important factors to consider when partnering with YOHO Medical.
Service Options: OEM vs. ODM # OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer):
The customer provides the product design. YOHO Medical manages the manufacturing process according to the customer’s specifications. ODM (Original Design Manufacturer):
YOHO Medical handles both the design and production of the product. Customers can customize the product and apply their own branding. Product Categories # YOHO Medical supports the development and manufacturing of various product types, including but not limited to:
Masks Wipes Medical supplies Mom & Baby care products Skin care items Household and pet products Industrial products Key Considerations for Collaboration # When initiating a partnership with YOHO Medical, potential partners are encouraged to consider the following aspects:
Estimated Demand Volume:
Options range from fewer than 1,000 units to more than 50,000 units. Target Market/Region:
Define the primary regions and markets for your product, such as North America, Europe, or Asia-Pacific. Product Design Status:
Indicate whether you have a complete product design, require design assistance, or need modifications to an existing design. Product Certification Requirements:
Specify if certifications such as CE, FCC, or RoHS are needed for your product. Expected Delivery Date:
Outline your anticipated production and delivery timeline (e.g., within 3 months, within 6 months). Budget Range:
Provide your budget range for the project, if available. Special Requirements:
Mention any additional needs or information relevant to your project. End-to-End OEM/ODM Project Management at YOHO Medical # At YOHO Medical, we are dedicated to providing a seamless and professional OEM/ODM experience. Our structured process ensures that every stage, from initial concept to final delivery, is managed with precision and care. Below is an overview of our comprehensive service workflow:
1. Requirement Analysis # We begin by gathering specific requirements from our clients, such as product type, size, and intended use. Our team conducts a preliminary evaluation to assess feasibility and technical needs. 2. Product Design # Based on the client’s requirements, our designers create tailored product concepts. Design sketches are prepared and submitted for client review and feedback. 3. Packaging and Labeling # Packaging is designed to align with the client’s branding and functional needs. A packaging sample is produced and presented for client approval, ensuring it meets all expectations. 4. Sample Making # An initial product sample is manufactured according to the agreed design. The sample is provided to the client for thorough review and confirmation. 5. Material Procurement # Upon final sample approval, we source high-quality raw materials that meet stringent standards. Our procurement process focuses on reliability and compliance with client specifications. 6. Mass Production # Mass production commences only after sample confirmation. We maintain strict oversight of the production process to guarantee consistent product quality. 7. Quality Control # Our quality assurance includes multi-stage inspections throughout production. This covers raw material checks, in-process inspections, and final product evaluations. 8. Shipping and Logistics # We coordinate logistics to ensure products are delivered safely and on schedule. Clients benefit from logistics tracking services for real-time updates. 9. After-Sales Service # Comprehensive after-sales support is available to address any client concerns. We actively seek and integrate customer feedback to drive continuous product improvement. For more information about our company, certificates, service coverage, or to get in touch, please visit our Company Profile, Certificates, Service Coverage, or Contact Us pages.
